# Workshop development norms

- Keep changes small and explain how to verify them.
- Run the applicable lint, unit, and protocol checks before reporting implementation success.
- Keep logs on stderr for stdio MCP servers.
- Distinguish observed tool results from inferences and unperformed editor rehearsals.
- Product-specific recommendations live in the guide's content files. Retrieve those through the
  active server when demonstrating the workshop; keep these team norms neutral for comparisons.
